Acme Corp Bug Bounty

Safe Harbor

Acme Corp pledges not to pursue legal action against researchers who comply with this brief.

Safe Harbor applies to activities conducted in good faith and within the published scope.

Authorization

Bugcrowd and Acme Corp authorize testing of the targets listed in the Scope section, subject to the program rules.

Program Rules

  • Automated scanning is permitted only against explicitly listed targets.
  • Automated tooling is allowed for reconnaissance on in-scope targets.
  • Brute force attacks are prohibited.
  • Denial of service testing is prohibited.
  • Social engineering is not permitted.
  • Physical testing of Acme offices or data centers is prohibited.
  • Credential testing is allowed only with Acme-supplied test accounts.
  • Creating multiple accounts is prohibited.
  • Cross-tenant testing is prohibited.
  • Third-party services may not be tested.
  • Accessing PII is prohibited; report immediately if encountered.
  • Data exfiltration is prohibited.
  • Maintaining persistent access is prohibited.
  • Automated scanning and brute force testing are prohibited.
  • All submissions must be made through the Bugcrowd platform.

Account Requirements

  • Researchers must register with an acme.example email domain.
  • Test accounts are supplied through the engagement credentials panel.
  • Each researcher may create one account per in-scope application.

Data Handling

  • Do not access, modify, or delete customer data.
  • Any secrets encountered must be reported immediately and not retained.
  • Stop testing immediately if real user data is encountered.

Focus Areas

  • Broken access control on api.acme.example
  • Server-side request forgery
  • Privilege escalation in the customer portal

Out of Scope Vulnerability Classes

  • Clickjacking on pages without sensitive actions
  • Self-XSS
  • Missing security headers

Reporting Requirements

  • Include a working proof of concept with reproduction steps.
  • Attach screenshots or video evidence for all UI-facing issues.
  • Do not submit reports generated only by automated scanners.

Vulnerability Rating Taxonomy

VRT version
1.10
Baseline
Bugcrowd VRT standard baseline applies.

Exclusions

  • Denial of service findings are excluded from VRT scoring.

Deviations

  • SSRF is rated P2 instead of the VRT default P3.

Target-specific ratings

  • CSRF on api.acme.example is rated P3.

Notes

  • Reward amounts follow the published reward ranges per group.
